Verification of record: locked check, clippy -D warnings, the offline m068_rollback:: suite, the m045_ext suite and the m016 suite plus the read-only attribution check — locked check+clippy+these suites are the proof because no unit-level live-network fetch test exists on the macOS host. T-001.Title: Two precise lockfile updates, mechanical NOTICES refresh, SummaryDelta dependency-fact notes and the locked green gates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Baseline evidence is recorded on the fresh head before any write: the pre-edit lock rows for both crates (the `name = "h2"` / `version = "0.4.14"` pair and the `name = "rustls-webpki"` / `version = "0.103.15"` pair, with checksums) and both NOTICES-rust.md rows, plus the inverse-graph note (rustls-webpki pulled by rustls 0.23.46 and rustls-platform-verifier 0.7.0; h2 pulled by hyper 1.10.1 and reqwest 0.13.5 — both crates transitive, absent from every Cargo.toml, no `[patch]` section) as the spec's re-verify-on-fresh-head requirement.

The update is exactly the two precise moves from the workspace root whose Cargo.lock this repository keeps: `cargo update -p rustls-webpki --precise 0.103.16` and `cargo update -p h2 --precise 0.4.16` — no direct dependency added, no `[patch]` section introduced, no Cargo.toml change of any kind, and a broad `cargo update` prohibited. `git diff Cargo.lock` shows exactly the two intended `[[package]]` moves with their checksum updates plus at most resolver-forced transitive entries, and any forced entry is individually listed with its forcing reason in the change bundle (or the diff is exactly the two entries).
